dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: ...Diona! Ah, great, you're not at the tavern today.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Is your father not back from hunting yet? I haven't seen him.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: He's resting up at home right now. Nothing serious, the wind was a bit chilly and he caught a cold. I'll take care of him.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: You came here for this, right? I prepared it already.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hmm? Wait! I hear someone coming!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: ...Meowza, it's you! Hmph. You startled me for a moment there.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Wh—Who's the scaredy cat, huh? Didn't you see me on the hunt the last time... Wait, no.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I mean, don't you know that I can catch beasties way bigger than I am?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Just now was because I... I was just being extra cautious, since these goods are special, okay?

choices.text: Are they strange alchemical reagents, then?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ahem... Oh, this is embarrassing... but if you're really curious, then you can have a look...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Broken bird bones, the staff of an Anemo Samachurl, and the baby teeth of... is that a wolf, or a dog?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Three forest boar ribs with the lingering scent of spices. A previous hunt's haul? Wait, it can't be leftovers from dinner, right?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh... Do staves count as bones?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Wow, you collected so much this time! Thank you, Diona!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I didn't bring my Tetrasour Wolfhooks or Type-V Bittermore Calla Lilies with me when I left home today, though... Will you be dropping by Mondstadt City tomorrow?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Nope. I've been too busy to go mix drinks lately — and I need to find time to hunt too.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: In that case, would you like this instead?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: It's a Valberry rich in carrot essence. Its color, fragrance, and nutritional values are all closer to traditional carrots.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: As such, I'm curious... Will it attract animals that like carrots, or will it attract animals of both flavor preferences?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Now that is an interesting question. Guess I can use it as bait, then?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Please do, and do tell me how the experiment turns out.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Say hello to Mr. Draff for me, would you? I wish him a speedy recovery.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Either way, I need to return soon. I've got a Mark-23 Ultra-Berserk Favonius Dragon Warrior to assemble...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What, you haven't learned yet, Diona?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Learn what? Who can even learn that kinda thing!?
